**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use a declarative Stimulus action for pointer tracking**

Declare this pointer hook in `DS::Dialog#merged_opts` alongside the existing click action instead of installing and removing it in `connect()`. The repository's Stimulus convention in `docs/llm-guides/ui.md:30-39` explicitly requires controller events to be exposed as HTML actions; this new listener adds a hidden event API and manual lifecycle bookkeeping.

Thanks for the reviews. Pushed a follow-up commit addressing them:
- Press tracking is now declared in HTML (`pointerdown->DS--dialog#trackPress`, `pointercancel->DS--dialog#clearPress`, `click->DS--dialog#clickOutside`) instead of imperative listeners, per the Stimulus convention in docs/llm-guides/ui.md.
- Only the primary pointer is tracked (`isPrimary === false` is ignored).
- The stored press is cleared on `pointercancel` (not on `pointerup`, since `click` fires after `pointerup` and still needs it).
- Keyboard-triggered clicks (`detail === 0`) ignore any stale press target.
- No controller-level DOM test was added: the repo has no JS DOM harness; the pure `shouldCloseOnClick` tests still pass (4/4).

Disclosure: this change was prepared with an AI coding assistant.
